reason: H0 fuzzes only the JSON decoder, while S1 exposes CBOR decoder limits and requirements without any CBOR harness. The CBOR decode_tokens entry point, CBOR input semantics, nested array/map recursion, and minimum source/token-buffer behavior are therefore fuzz-worthy surfaces not exercised by H0.
evidence: H0 contains fuzz/c/std/json_fuzzer.c and calls wuffs_json__decoder__initialize and wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens exclusively.
The case explicitly states that fuzz/c/std/cbor_fuzzer.c does not exist in H0.
S1 defines WUFFS_CBOR__DECODER_DEPTH_MAX_INCL as 1024, identifying deeply nested CBOR arrays and maps as a bounded decoder state.

S1 defines WUFFS_CBOR__DECODER_DST_TOKEN_BUFFER_LENGTH_MIN_INCL as 2 and WUFFS_CBOR__DECODER_SRC_IO_BUFFER_LENGTH_MIN_INCL as 9, identifying token-destination and streaming-source boundary conditions.
S1 includes CBOR decoder statuses wuffs_cbor__error__bad_input and wuffs_cbor__error__unsupported_recursion_depth, which are not reachable through the JSON-only harness.
recommended_action: Add a CBOR fuzz harness that initializes wuffs_cbor__decoder and drives wuffs_cbor__decoder__decode_tokens over arbitrary CBOR bytes, varying source and token-buffer limits around 9 and 2, handling short-read/short-write resumptions, checking token/I/O invariants, and exercising nested arrays/maps around WUFFS_CBOR__DECODER_DEPTH_MAX_INCL.
